verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is that compiling a graph runs 'a few basic checks on the structure of your graph (no orphaned nodes, etc)', which is a limited build-time structural validation. The docs also name State as a core graph component, but nothing shows typed state schemas or validation. Missing for 10: strict typing of state, nodes and edges; schema validation of state updates or tool inputs; type-checker integration that catches errors before runtime; independent or hands-on corroboration.
